general.name: General
followup_starters: How high was the peak fever and for how many days?
Any shortness of breath at rest or chest pain?
Any recent sick contacts or travel?

pediatrics.name: Pediatrics
pediatrics.red_flag_focus: dehydration, lethargy, respiratory distress, poor oral intake
followup_starters: How many wet diapers or urinations in the past 24 hours?
Any difficulty breathing, nasal flaring, or retractions?
Is the child drinking fluids and behaving normally?

physiotherapy.name: Physiotherapy
physiotherapy.red_flag_focus: neurologic deficit, fracture risk, cauda equina symptoms
followup_starters: What movement patterns worsen or relieve symptoms?
Any numbness, tingling, or progressive weakness?
Any trauma or fall preceding symptoms?
test_starters: Imaging only if red flags present

dermatology.name: Dermatology
dermatology.red_flag_focus: mucosal involvement, rapidly spreading rash, systemic symptoms
followup_starters: When did the rash start and how has it changed?
Any mucosal lesions, fever, or skin pain?
Any new products, medications, or exposures?
